xwikidoc.title: Custom Results page for the Documentation LiveTables
xwikidoc.content: {{include reference="XWiki.LiveTableResultsMacros" /}} {{velocity wiki="false"}} #** * Displays the location of each listed page under its title, so that readers can tell apart pages having the same * title. The location is relative to the given root (the scope of the Live Data): it holds the titles of the pages * between the root and the listed page, each linking to its page. It's empty for the pages right below the root. * The title of the row is thus replaced by HTML (the link to the page followed by its location), to be displayed with * the "html" Live Data displayer. Sorting and filtering are still done on the page title. * * @param $rows the rows of the live table results, as built by #gridresultwithfilter_buildJSON * @param $rootReference the reference of the space from which locations start; when null, or when it's not an * ancestor of a listed page (the "location" filter of the Live Data matches substrings of page references), * the full location of that page is displayed *# #macro (docapp_addTitleLocations $rows $rootReference) #set ($docapp_defaultDocumentName = $services.model.getEntityReference('DOCUMENT', 'default').name) ## The listed pages often share their ancestors (e.g. the siblings of a page), so compute each ancestor once. #set ($docapp_ancestorHTMLs = {}) #foreach ($docapp_row in $rows) #if ($docapp_row.doc_viewable) #set ($docapp_rowReference = $services.model.resolveDocument($docapp_row.doc_fullName)) #set ($docapp_spaceReferences = $docapp_rowReference.spaceReferences) ## The page of the last space is the listed page itself when it's a nested page, so it's not part of its location. #set ($docapp_endIndex = $docapp_spaceReferences.size()) #if ($docapp_rowReference.name == $docapp_defaultDocumentName) #set ($docapp_endIndex = $docapp_endIndex - 1) #end ## indexOf returns -1 when there's no root or when it's not an ancestor, which displays the full location. #set ($docapp_startIndex = $docapp_spaceReferences.indexOf($rootReference) + 1) #set ($docapp_locationHTML = '') #if ($docapp_startIndex < $docapp_endIndex) #foreach ($docapp_spaceReference in $docapp_spaceReferences.subList($docapp_startIndex, $docapp_endIndex)) #set ($docapp_ancestorHTML = $docapp_ancestorHTMLs.get($docapp_spaceReference)) #if ("$!docapp_ancestorHTML" == '') #set ($docapp_ancestorReference = $services.model.createDocumentReference($docapp_defaultDocumentName, $docapp_spaceReference)) #set ($docapp_ancestorDocument = $NULL) #if ($services.security.authorization.hasAccess('view', $docapp_ancestorReference)) #set ($docapp_ancestorDocument = $xwiki.getDocument($docapp_ancestorReference)) #end #if ("$!docapp_ancestorDocument" != '' && !$docapp_ancestorDocument.isNew()) #set ($docapp_ancestorTitle = $docapp_ancestorDocument.translatedDocument.plainTitle) #set ($docapp_ancestorURL = $xwiki.getURL($docapp_ancestorReference)) #set ($docapp_ancestorHTML = "$escapetool.xml($docapp_ancestorTitle)") #else ## Don't display the title of a page that the current user can't view, nor link to a missing page. #set ($docapp_ancestorHTML = $escapetool.xml($docapp_spaceReference.name)) #end #set ($discard = $docapp_ancestorHTMLs.put($docapp_spaceReference, $docapp_ancestorHTML)) #end #if ($foreach.index > 0) #set ($docapp_locationHTML = "${docapp_locationHTML} › ") #end #set ($docapp_locationHTML = "${docapp_locationHTML}${docapp_ancestorHTML}") #end #end #set ($docapp_titleHTML = "$escapetool.xml($docapp_row.doc_title)") #if ($docapp_locationHTML != '') #set ($docapp_titleHTML = "${docapp_titleHTML}${docapp_locationHTML}") #end #set ($discard = $docapp_row.put('doc_title', $docapp_titleHTML)) #end #end #end ## Exclude the DocApp Code and Data spaces so that entries from there are not listed in LiveDatas. #set ($extra = 'AND doc.space <> :docapp_code_space AND doc.space <> :docapp_data_space') #set ($params = {'docapp_code_space' : 'DocApp.Code', 'docapp_data_space' : 'DocApp.Data'}) ## Also exclude the current page, if asked. #if ("$!request.current" != '') #set ($extra = "$extra AND doc.fullName <> :docapp_currentdoc") #set ($discard = $params.put('docapp_currentdoc', "$!request.current")) #end ## Use filterLocation since addLivetableLocationFilter is buggy when called several times (it'll add the ## same HQL binding name every time it's called! See https://jira.xwiki.org/browse/XWIKI-17463). ## Also note that we don't call addLocationFilter since we use a Map for $params. #filterLocation($extra, $params, $!request.location, 'locationFilterValue1') ## Same as #gridresultwithfilter, but adjusting the rows before serializing them. #if ($xcontext.action == 'get' && "$!request.outputSyntax" == 'plain') #set ($map = {}) #gridresultwithfilter_buildJSON("$!request.classname" $request.collist.split(',') '' "${extra}" $params $map) ## The pages display their location under their title when the Live Data asks for it (it must then use the "html" ## displayer for the title). The location is relative to the given root space, which is the scope of the Live Data ## (the "location" filter can't be used for it since it's a substring of the page references, not a space). #if ("$!request.titleLocation" == 'true') #set ($docapp_rootReference = $NULL) #if ("$!request.titleLocationRoot" != '') #set ($docapp_rootReference = $services.model.resolveSpace($request.titleLocationRoot)) #end #docapp_addTitleLocations($map.rows $docapp_rootReference) #end #jsonResponse($map) #end {{/velocity}}
